children: The rate of new home sales rose in August. Here are the main takeaways from the report released by the Census Bureau and the Department of Housing and Urban Development:
Sales of new single-family homes rose to 684,000 in August, from 643,000 in July.
A consensus of economists polled by The Wall Street Journal expected 618,000 new sales in August.
The estimate for new houses for sale was 483,000 in August, virtually unchanged from the July estimate of 483,000, the Commerce Department said.
The median sales price of new houses sold in August was $393,700, above the July price of $392,200.
